name: Love es M
source:
A kind and reliable older sister, Mizushiro Ayaka. 
A younger childhood friend and now my girlfriend, Tsurutani Ayaka.
While I'm happily getting along with the two, I wasn't satisfied. That is because I have a hobby that I cannot let surface.

I want to do, S&M. 

I sneakily buy tools for my personal use, stare at them, touch them. One day as I was expelling myself of my urges, I noticed that someone had entered my room, and closed on to that secret.

"Let's try setting a trap"

I expose who discovered that secret. And so, our abnormal relationship began.

[From [url=http://www.gungnir.co.jp/noesis/products/lovesm/index.html]Noesis Homepage[/url]]
translation:
善良可靠的姐姐，水代绫香。
鹤谷绫香是我儿时的好友，现在是我的女朋友。
虽然我和两个人相处得很愉快，但我并不满足。那是因为我有一个我不能公开的爱好。

我想做，S&M。

我偷偷地买了一些自用的工具，盯着它们，摸它们。有一天，当我正在驱逐自己的冲动时，我注意到有人进入了我的房间，并关闭了这个秘密。

“我们来尝试设个陷阱吧”

我揭露谁发现了这个秘密。就这样，我们不正常的关系开始了。
